context: Checkpoint 2026-08-03 (late). The declared-node-base work is COMPLETE, both open decisions taken. The node resolves declarations from what it was told (SOVEREIGN_BASE, injected like SOVEREIGN_DIR) across all seven Group A+B sites and forwards them to the operation child, so it no longer admits an operation from one directory and refuses it from another — proven with the daemon deliberately started from the repository: exitCode 0, succeeded, 10 packages, 0 issues. `refarm auth`'s default policy is now the NODE's, at resolveRefarmHome, with --policy the explicit way to differ; the enrolment boundary held because resolveRefarmHome reads no declaration. And the node publishes <refarm-dir>/node.json (node-descriptor.v1) at boot carrying its declaration base and pid, so `refarm doctor` compares against the RUNNING node instead of inferring — a file rather than a route, because every sidecar route is DeviceOnly and asking your own node about itself must not need a device credential. Staleness is answered by kill(pid, 0), never a timestamp. Four existing guards corrected the implementation along the way and each was right.
